from itertools import combinations

marks = [0, 2, 3, 7, 13, 21, 30]

print(f"Marks: {marks}")
print(f"Number of marks: {len(marks)}")
print(f"x[0] = {marks[0]} (must be 0) ✓" if marks[0]==0 else "FAIL x[0]")
print(f"x[1] = {marks[1]} (must be 2) ✓" if marks[1]==2 else "FAIL x[1]")
print(f"Sorted ascending: {marks == sorted(marks)} ✓")

dists = {}
for i, j in combinations(range(len(marks)), 2):
    d = marks[j] - marks[i]
    dists[(i,j)] = d
    print(f"  marks[{i}]-marks[{j}]: {marks[j]}-{marks[i]} = {d}")

dist_values = list(dists.values())
print(f"\nAll {len(dist_values)} distances unique: {len(dist_values) == len(set(dist_values))} ✓")
